scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh? Do I know you? It's creepy that you seem so familiar. You don't have a twin, do you?

[Thief Guide]
What, do you want to be a Thief? I'm sorry, but you look like you need more training.

[Thief Guide]
Take your time and learn all the Basic Skills, will you? Well then, see you later~!

[Thief Guide]
Well, I got this feeling like you've been through a lifetime of fighting, so I'm promoting you to a Thief right this minute. I better give you tough guys what you want...

[Thief Guide]
Since you've become a Thief, live as a Thief. Now, go for it! Next~

[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.

[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby~

[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!

[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!

[Thief Guide]
If you have a problem, feel free to speak to me anytime, alright?

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Huh.
Now, that's
a big sword.

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
What's a Mage doin' here? Shouldn't you be doing card tricks elsewhere? Oh well, it's a free country...

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You're a Merchant,
right? Why are you
walking into a den
of Thieves?!

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Oh my God...
Am I dying?

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Didn't you use to be one of us?! Man, you changed. You seem real dangerous now...

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, you got real cool all of a sudden! You must have some skills I can only dream of!

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
Man, shouldn't you
Archers be playing
in the forest
or something?

[Thief Guide]
What the heck...?
You know we all steal for a living, right? What are you doing in this kinda place, Acolyte?

[Thief Guide]
So...
Trying to make
up for something
...Buddy?

[Thief Guide]
Oh wait,
it's not...
Get outta here!

[Thief Guide]
It's like you're begging
us to steal from you!
Come on, hurry and
get outta here~

[Thief Guide]
Why else would a Priest come here? I guess I better start confessing all of my misdeeds.

[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Look, there's really no need for you to be in this kind of place. You oughta go where you ought to go.

[Thief Guide]
Hmmm?
You gathered Mushrooms for
the Thief test, right?

[Thief Guide]
Here, talk to the other guy right next to me. He's the one in charge of checking your Mushrooms.

[Thief Guide]
So how was the
Mushroom Farm?
Have any fun?
Yeah, kinda Cool.
It was horrible.

[Thief Guide]
Heh heh! That's a good attitude. In our line of work, you gotta enjoy getting your hands dirty, one way or another.

[Thief Guide]
Yeah? I've been there too, so I can see why that place isn't everyone's cup of tea. Still, being a Thief isn't all glamour and trendy night life.

[Thief Guide]
Hey, whaddya doin' here? Aren't you supposed to be gathering Mushrooms? Or did you need it explained to you again?
Yes.
No, that's okay.

[Thief Guide]
*Sigh* Well, there's always one in the bunch. Alright, listen carefully.

[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from a farm. Don't worry, the guy who owns the farm deserves to be robbed.

[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.

[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.

[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.

[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.

[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.

[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.

[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.

[Thief Guide]
Huh. For a second there, I thought you had something really important to tell me.

[Thief Guide]
What brings you down
here to this rathole?

[Thief Guide]
Ah...
You came back.
Are you sure you're
ready to try again?
Hey, I came here to be a Thief!
Nah, I'm just looking around.

[Thief Guide]
Heh, I like your confidence. Still, you know being a Thief isn't all what it's cracked up to be.

[Thief Guide]
Still...
Do you really
want to be
a Thief?
Yeah.
No, just wasting your time.
Why did you become a Thief?

[Thief Guide]
Really...

[Thief Guide]
Yeah...
I can see that.

[Thief Guide]
Me...?
I had no choice at the time. It was either steal or starve. But it's not like I need to give you my life story.

[Thief Guide]
So do you want to
apply to become
a Thief or not?
Yes, I will.
I'm too scared to be a Thief!

[Thief Guide]
Alright, tell
me your name.

[Thief Guide]
{0}?
What kind of name is {1}? Anyway, give me a second.

[Thief Guide]
Alright, your registration has been processed. Okay, you can begin your test if you're ready.
Yeah, I'm ready.
No, I'm not ready yet.

[Thief Guide]
Not ready?
How can you
not be ready?!

[Thief Guide]
Too scared?!?
Hahahahahahah!
Oh, please...!
That's hilarious!

[Thief Guide]
Okay...
Give me
one second.

[Thief Guide]
Your name is...
{0}? Um, where is it? Ah, here it is. Let's see...

[Thief Guide]
Isn't that cute? I can see you're ambitious, but you gotta learn all of the Basic Skills before you can become a Thief.

[Thief Guide]
Alright. I looked at your Felony Record, and you seem to have a very interesting history. You might have what it takes to be a Thief.

[Thief Guide]
Because I feel like it, I now decree that you have passed this interview. Good work!

[Thief Guide]
Now, your actual abilities will need to be tested. Do you know anything about the test?
Yes, I do.
Sorry, I don't.

[Thief Guide]
Oh yeah? Well, this makes things a lot easier.

[Thief Guide]
Alright, let me inform you then. Listen carefully. This test decides if you are worthy of becoming a Thief.

[Thief Guide]
You will be sneaking to Shibu's Farm. He is the worst Merchant, in terms of character, in Morocc.

[Thief Guide]
Alright, for your test, you gotta steal Mushrooms from his farm. Don't worry, that guy deserves to be robbed.

[Thief Guide]
Anyway, you gotta gather two kinds of Mushrooms: ^0000FFOrange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^0000FFOrange Gooey Mushrooms^000000.

[Thief Guide]
Be careful, since there are monsters are the farm that are there to protect the Mushrooms. So this will be no walk in the park.

[Thief Guide]
When you come back here after gathering Mushrooms, you'll be graded on the Mushrooms you've collected.

[Thief Guide]
Each Orange Net Mushroom gets you 3 points, and you get 1 point for each Orange Gooey Mushroom. You need a total of 25 points to pass the test.

[Thief Guide]
Go outside and keep going ahead toward the Eastern Field of the Pyramids. Then you will see one of our comrades between two columns.

[Thief Guide]
Speak to that guy, and he'll take you to the farm through the backdoor.

[Thief Guide]
On that field, I think his coordinates are '^FF0000141, 125^000000.' Just type ^3355FF/where^000000 in the right side of your chat box to check your present coordinates.

[Thief Guide]
Don't forget to make plans and prepare yourself before you go inside the Mushroom Farm. Move as quickly as you can and try not to get killed, alright?

[Brad]
We don't have any special events yet. Come some other time when there's news, alright?

[Comrade]
Um...
You don't look
like a Thief.

[Comrade]
What the heck are
you doing here anyway?

[Comrade]
What's the matter? If you want to be a Thief, speak to the girl beside me.

[Comrade]
Did you pass the interview?
Then what are you waiting for?

[Comrade]
Ah, the guide told me about you. So, let me check your mushrooms...

[Comrade]
What the hell...
You don't have any Mushrooms at all! Go back and get them. Otherwise, you won't pass the test and become a Thief!

[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {1} you gathered.

[Comrade]
Now I'll just check your Orange Gooey Mushrooms. That's {0} you gathered.

[Comrade]
First, let me check the Orange Net Mushrooms you got.
Huh, {0} of them.
[Comrade]

[Comrade]
So that would
bring your total to...

[Comrade]
Hmmm. {0} degrees, multiplied by the speed of light, divided by the integral of pi times height plus the absolute value of politics...

[Comrade]
Okay!
I got it.

[Comrade]
Definitely less than the 25 points you need to pass. Go out there and get me more Mushrooms!

[Comrade]
You got more
than 25 points!
Awesome!

[Comrade]
Exactly 25 points!
You did it! Badass!

[Comrade]
{0}...
You have passed the official Thief Test. You are now one of us.

[Comrade]
Congratulations on becoming a Thief! From now, be an honorable representative of the Thief's Guild.

[Comrade]
If you bring disgrace to our guild, you will be killed. I expect you to bring our comrades pride.

[Brad]
*Ahem* Welcome to the Guild, comrade! I'm Brad, and I'm in charge of human resources here.

[Brad]
Here is a small subsidy for a Newbie like you. Spend it whereever you want. Alright then, I'll see you around~

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Ah, I see that you are now a Thief. I always knew you'd join us.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Stealing from a Mushroom farm is too easy for you now. You should build up your skills and master our craft.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
I could use a good, hard drink.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Gimme your money.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
WHO YOU CALLING A PSYCHO?!?!

[Mr. Irrelevant]
I've got nothing to say to you. Would you mind leaving me alone?

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Today looks like a good day to go to the pyramids and hunt with some of my friends.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Kidding, I'm off the clock.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hahahahaha~!
You haven't
passed the test yet?
Alright, I'll let you in...

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hmm...
You've come to take the test, right? I can see in your eyes that you know something.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Your name is {0}? Ah, it's on the list. Alright, I'll let you into the Mushroom Farm , but I can't guarantee your safety...

[Mr. Irrelevant]
There is this strange smell coming from... You. Now why would that be?

[Mr. Irrelevant]
Hey Novice! Why don't you join the ranks of the Thief Guild? You newbies are always welcome to join us and our selfish cause.

[Mr. Irrelevant]
You can get more information in the Underground Room in the Pyramid 1 BF.
